# WP-007: Intake and source model

Status: PLANNED, NOT AUTHORIZED.
Owner and approver: Michael Maillet. Formal scope approval: PENDING.
Dependencies: WP-006.
Governing requirements: REQ-INTAKE-001.

## Original plan scope and acceptance

**Objective:** Ingest repositories, commits, diffs, and review contracts without ambiguity.

**Scope:** Git identity checks, clean-state enforcement, file classification, Python AST/CST parsing, line mapping, dependency graph seed, unsupported-file handling.

**Acceptance evidence:** Fixtures for renames, deleted lines, syntax errors, generated files, symlinks, submodules, dirty trees, and Unicode paths; exact reviewed SHA appears in every artifact.

**Rollback:** Reject unsupported intake modes and accept explicit local directories only.

## Session outputs and rollback

S1: implementation, tests, raw local logs, handoff and distinct commit.
S2: independent read-only audit report and distinct commit.
S3: finding-only fixes or no-change verification, independent delta review and
distinct commit. S4: docs, registers, local acceptance, approval and distinct commit.
No session is implicitly complete. Preserve evidence when rolling back the
capability or restoring a prior baseline; accepted records use errata.
